channel.title: AVIZ PRO
channel.description: AVIZ PRO for Mac — updates for the version downloaded from aviz.studio.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.6
item.description:
AVIZ PRO 1.0.6

  • New effects: Lens (refraction, soft edges and camera settings), Pixel stretch, Scan box, Fiber cell and Glass capsule, with ready-made presets and templates.
  • Licence activation: a licence works on up to two Macs. Deactivate a Mac in the licence window to move it to another one; without a network the app keeps working for 30 days.
  • Local AI agents (MCP) are now off until you turn them on, and an agent’s permission lasts until you quit AVIZ PRO.
  • Security: agent previews no longer show camera, NDI or Syphon frames; shaders from other people’s projects are size-limited and can’t include files from your disk.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.5
item.description:
AVIZ PRO 1.0.5

  • Palettes in the inspector are shown as colour swatches instead of hex codes.
  • Tracks that macOS can't open directly (extra data before the audio, AAC saved as .mp3) now play; a truly damaged file shows a clear message.
  • Node cards on the map are always opaque, and the selected card stays on top.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.4
item.description:
AVIZ PRO 1.0.4

  • Ableton Link: AVIZ PRO keeps tempo, beat and phase with Ableton Live and other Link apps on your network. Turn it on with the Ableton Link button in the tempo zone, in the Playback menu or in the new Ableton Link tab in Settings.
  • Ableton Link settings: a map of the devices in the session — other Macs with AVIZ PRO by name and model, apps that share audio through Link Audio by name — with Reload and Find New Devices for a device that isn't visible.
  • Start Stop Sync: when it is on, Play and Stop in AVIZ PRO start and stop the Link session.
  • A new tempo zone under the timeline: big BPM, the Ableton Link button and a large Tap pad. In the expanded audio lane a VU meter kicks on every beat.
  • Loops and Repeat One play seamlessly, playback continues when you switch the audio output, and the position bar under the transport can be clicked and dragged.
  • The window stays smooth with Link on: the meters and the tempo zone no longer redraw the whole window.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.3
item.description:
AVIZ PRO 1.0.3

  • 12 interface languages: English, Ukrainian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. AVIZ PRO follows your macOS language.
  • Master output layers in the inspector, a "What to control?" menu when you drop a wire, and Audio binds that work as in Lite.
  • Detailed audio view: waveform, spectrogram, dB bands, kick and sections, with a timeline ruler, snap, scrub and an A–B loop.
  • Transport with stop, sections, loop and speed. The preview can shrink into a corner, and Esc leaves full screen.
  • 13 interface themes, an adaptive layout with "Reset layout", and your own project tabs.
  • Scrolling no longer turns knobs by accident, and ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z undo and redo one gesture at a time.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.1
item.description:
AVIZ PRO 1.0.1

  • Fixed a crash when opening a scene with text effects (for example Phonk punch) while the node map was being laid out.
  • Road: the sun is no longer doubled in the wet asphalt reflection.
  • The project title no longer shows the .avizproj extension; the shader editor shows code right away.

item.title: AVIZ PRO 1.0.0
item.description: • The first release of AVIZ PRO for Mac.
